service.name: Daytime sound bath
service.serviceType: Sound bath for yoga studios, workplaces, senior centers, hospices, recovery centers, schools and retreats during the day
service.description: A seventy-five-minute sound bath from Firstwater booked during the day: a Sunday morning class at a yoga studio, a lunchtime session at an office, an afternoon at a senior center or a senior living community, a staff day at a school, a session at a hospice or a recovery center, or the morning that opens a retreat, across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor, with the sound system, mats, blankets and waivers brought to the venue.

faqs.q: Can a yoga studio book a sound bath as a class or a workshop?
faqs.a: Yes. Firstwater comes to the studio with the sound system, the mats, the blankets and the waivers, sets up about ninety minutes before doors, and runs a seventy-five-minute session on the studio's own schedule: a Sunday morning, a Saturday afternoon, a workshop slot, the session before a retreat weekend. The facilitator tunes the sound system to the studio before the doors open.

faqs.q: Does a sound bath work at an office at lunchtime?
faqs.a: Yes. It needs a conference space or a cleared floor with enough space for everyone to lie down, a standard outlet, low light, and about ninety minutes of setup ahead of doors. The session itself is seventy-five minutes, which fits a long lunch, and nobody has to say a word.

faqs.q: Is a sound bath suitable for seniors and senior centers?
faqs.a: Yes. It's the same seventy-five-minute session at a senior center or a senior living community, and a resident who can't get down to a mat rests in a seat or a recliner instead. Nobody is asked to do anything but rest, and the facilitator tunes the sound system to the space.

faqs.q: Can you bring a sound bath to a school, a hospice or a recovery center?
faqs.a: Yes. Firstwater books for schools, hospices and hospitals as well as companies: a staff day at a school, a session for families or staff at a hospice, a session in a recovery program. Tell us who will be in the space and we'll plan it with you.

faqs.q: What does a venue need to host a sound bath?
faqs.a: Enough floor for everyone to lie down, a standard outlet, low light, and about ninety minutes before doors. Everything else, the sound system, the mats, the blankets and the waivers, arrives with the facilitator. If your space won't work, the session runs in a partner space in Denver.

faqs.q: How much does a daytime sound bath cost?
faqs.a: We publish no prices of our own. Send the date, the headcount and the space, and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price for that session. A sound bath in the morning and live music that evening is one booking on one contract.
